summary: Vermilion Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, announcing a cash dividend of $0.135 CDN per common share payable on June 30, 2026, to shareholders of record on June 15, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is involved. The filing is a standard disclosure of a regular quarterly dividend, which occurs in the ordinary course of business. As a non-US filing (Canadian issuer), it is equivalent to an 8-K for US companies but carries no special-situation significance.
